name: Chattanooga

neighborhoods.name: St. Elmo
neighborhoods.homes: historic houses at the foot of Lookout Mountain

housing: Chattanooga's rentals are a mix of older houses in neighborhoods like Highland Park and St. Elmo, new apartment buildings downtown and on the Southside, and suburban complexes.

tenantHelp.name: Legal Aid of East Tennessee
tenantHelp.what: free legal help for low-income renters, including evictions

climate: Test the air conditioning and check basements, gutters and hillside drainage for water; summers are humid and heavy rain is common.
fact: EPB, the city-owned power company, provides fiber internet across Chattanooga, so most rentals can get it.
